# Sinnoh

[Back to the guide](../players-guide.md#part-2-walkthrough-and-strategy)

Sinnoh has 54 Explore areas and a ladder of 8 gyms, 4 Elite Four seats and a champion. Its areas come from Platinum.

How to read the tables: **Chance** is the share of that area's encounters, once the whole story is open. **Level** is what you meet. A Pokemon marked *later in the story* shows up only after more badges. Johto, Sinnoh and Paldea change with the clock: morning is 04:00-10:00, day 10:00-18:00, night 18:00-04:00 (a board with no clock counts as day).

#### Gym 1: Roark (Oreburgh) -- the Coal Badge
Rock specialist. 3 Pokemon, best level 14: your team fights at level 14 at most, and on hard you bring 3 at most. Prize money: $700 on easy, $1,400 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Geodude | Rock/Ground | 12 | Bulldoze, Rock Throw, Tackle, Harden |
| Onix | Rock/Ground | 12 | Bulldoze, Rock Tomb, Rock Throw, Tackle |
| Cranidos | Rock | 14 | Ancientpower, Bite, Rock Smash, Tackle |

**Hit them with** Steel, Ground, Fighting moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Fighting, Ground, Rock, Dark. **Careful with** Fire, Ice, Rock Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Tested team:** Golduck, Psyduck, Machop, Budew, Onix, Geodude. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Sinnoh by this point, raised to level 14 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **100%** on hard (bringing the first 3).

### The Pokemon League

The four Elite Four seats and the champion are one run: HP comes back for every fight, PP does not, and you cannot put your Pokemon to bed until it ends. See [the League](../players-guide.md#9-gyms-and-the-pokemon-league).

#### Elite Four, seat 1: Aaron
Bug specialist. 5 Pokemon, best level 53: your team fights at level 53 at most, and on hard you bring 5 at most. Prize money: $2,650 on easy, $5,300 on hard (half again for a rematch).

| Pokemon | Type | Level | Moves |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yanmega | Bug/Flying | 49 | Bug Buzz, Crunch, Aerial Ace, Silver Wind |
| Scizor | Bug/Steel | 49 | Close Combat, Iron Head, X-Scissor, Metal Claw |
| Vespiquen | Bug/Flying | 50 | Bug Buzz, Silver Wind, Power Gem, Struggle Bug |
| Heracross | Bug/Fighting | 51 | Close Combat, Double-Edge, Take Down, Rock Smash |
| Drapion | Poison/Dark | 53 | Crunch, X-Scissor, Bite, Poison Sting |

**Hit them with** Fire, Flying, Rock moves. **Their attacks are** Normal, Fighting, Poison, Flying, Bug, Rock, Dark, Steel. **Careful with** Grass, Ice, Psychic Pokemon: several of those attacks hit them hard. **Tested team:** Garchomp, Mamoswine, Mantine, Clefable, Magmortar, Toxicroak. Chosen by simulated battles from the Pokemon you can catch in Sinnoh by this point, raised to level 53 and evolved by level where they can; with IVs around 20 and training 75 it won **100%** of battles on easy and **95%** on hard (bringing the first 5).
